scope: A diagnostic checklist of published research names, not a census, random sample or global coverage percentage. A name candidate in the graph does not certify identity, current role or AI relevance. Unresolved identities and missing paths remain explicit.
scopeZh: 这是用于发现缺口的研究者姓名诊断名单，不是普查、随机样本或全球覆盖率；图中出现姓名候选不等于独立核验了身份、当前职位或 AI 相关性。未解决的身份和路径缺口明确保留。
